text.setup: Hands a little wider than shoulder-width, palms away, hanging with straight arms.
cues: Pull your shoulders down first, then drive your elbows to your sides.
Get your chin over the bar.
Lower all the way to straight arms.
mistakes: Kipping or swinging to get up.
Half reps that never reach straight arms.
Craning the neck to get the chin over.

variants.machine: An assisted machine takes off some body weight — less assistance means harder.
variants.resistance_band: A band under your knees or feet helps most at the bottom.
variants.plate: Weight on a belt or between your feet; keep the legs still.
